entry.summaryHtml: Hickory smoke, charred oak, earth, barbecue spice and a rounded sweetness give the Sweet Ponies a compact fire-cured profile that is both savoury and sugary. The sweetened edge softens the dry wood and campfire character without hiding it, leaving a smoky, slightly peppery finish that should stay distinctive even in the short 4″ × 32 format.
